title: Redemplo decision, severe hypertriglyceridemia
description: The FDA has set no published date. Arrowhead has submitted an sNDA for plozasiran in severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) and is 'preparing for a potential U.S. launch in sHTG in the second quarter of 2027, pending successful regulatory filing, review, and approval' (FY2026 10-K 0000879407-26-000078, filed 2026-11-12; the same words in the results release furnished on 8-K 0000879407-26-000077). On 2026-10-07 Arrowhead announced the FDA had granted the sNDA entry into its STAR pilot program, which qualifies it for a six-month priority review, and the FDA 'will generally target' an action at least one month before that goal date. Under STAR the review goal period starts only on the second, completing submission, and no filing dates that submission, so no PDUFA or action date is disclosed. Dated to the end of the quarter in which the launch is guided; the decision falls on or before it.
